title: Semantic Kernel Architecture & Core Abstractions
description: Master Microsoft Semantic Kernel v1.x: Kernel builder, DI integration, ChatCompletionService, streaming, and execution filters in .NET.

data.text: Microsoft Semantic Kernel (SK) is an enterprise open-source SDK that integrates Large Language Models (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, HuggingFace, local models) with conventional C# code. In SK v1.x, the framework underwent a complete architectural modernization: it aligns directly with standard .NET dependency injection (IServiceCollection), leverages standard Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, and introduces a robust filter pipeline for cross-cutting observability and security.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Semantic Kernel v1.x is engineered to integrate natively with standard .NET dependency injection
The Kernel acts as the central coordinator binding AI connectors, plugins, and execution filters
Use builder.Services.AddKernel() and builder.Services.AddAzureOpenAIChatCompletion() for clean DI setup
Implement IFunctionInvocationFilter and IPromptRenderFilter for enterprise auditing, logging, and rate-limiting
Combine prompt templates and native C# plugins within the same unified execution context
data.takeaway: Semantic Kernel brings enterprise-grade dependency injection, testability, and middleware filtering to AI engineering in .NET, turning raw LLMs into maintainable software components.
